arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from icalendar import Calendar
cal = Calendar.from_ical(open('project_kickoff_meeting.ics','rb').read())
for c in cal.walk():
    if c.name == 'VEVENT':
        print('Summary:', c.get('summary'))
        print('Start:', c.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('End:', c.get('dtend').dt)
        print('Status:', c.get('status'))
print('Valid ICS')
" 2>/dev/null || echo "icalendar not installed; skipping validation"
